headline: Retired Teacher Plants 10,000 Oak Seedlings Across Southern California
meta_description: A retired science teacher has grown and distributed 10,000 oak seedlings to Southern California communities, including fire-ravaged Altadena.
summary_short: A retired California science teacher has grown 10,000 oak seedlings and entrusted them to communities across Southern California, helping restore forests damaged by fire.
body:
A retired California science teacher has grown and entrusted 10,000 oak seedlings to communities across Southern California, bringing hope to fire-ravaged regions like Altadena.

The educator's effort represents more than a numbers game—it's a commitment to hands-on restoration. By distributing seedlings directly to local communities, he's empowering residents to rebuild their own landscapes and reconnect with nature after devastating wildfires.

Altadena, one of the hardest-hit areas, now has the chance to reclaim its tree canopy with these native oak saplings. The project transforms a retired teacher's expertise into tangible environmental healing, showing how individual initiative can address large-scale ecological damage one seedling at a time.
quick_facts: Retired science teacher grew 10,000 oak seedlings
Direct community involvement in tree restoration
